_about: Editorial data for the United Kingdom country hub (/country/united-kingdom/) and its health page, written in task 171. Figures are never stored here: pages take them from src/data/profiles/GBR.json and the generated series.
name: United Kingdom

factChecks.against: RAC, Driving on the left or right across the world: United Kingdom – L
factChecks.label: driving on the left

factChecks.against: GOV.UK guidance: 999 and 112 are the UK national emergency numbers; 112 can be used instead of 999
factChecks.label: emergency numbers 999 or 112

changelog.note: Driving side and emergency numbers added after a hand check against the cited sources (task 172).

verification.what: Every statistic row (value, year, world rank) on the page, every number in the text, title, description and JSON-LD, and every claim in the story and FAQ (ranks, comparisons, trends, our counts); the build also asserts each claim (assertClaim); driving side and emergency numbers by hand on 27 November 2026, task 172 (factChecks)
verification.against: Original UN WPP 2024, UN WUP 2025 and World Bank WDI files read by scripts/verify/batch-171.py (independent of the site code); energy rows by check-energy and country facts by check-facts against their original files

verification.what: Every figure in the text, cards, Key facts, title, description, JSON-LD, statistic rows and every cell of the yearly table; every claim in the story, chart captions and FAQ (ranks, comparisons, trends, our counts)
verification.against: Original World Bank WDI files read by scripts/verify/batch-171.py; check-country-pages compares the table and CSV with the World Bank values
